digest.component_or_area: DC outbound mutation fitting and sanitization
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, allowing truncation logic to re-emit changes indefinitely on a second pass rather than converging to a fixed value

the DC comment sanitizer is bound to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) via _shared_sanitize_comment but the ceiling's provenance is undocumented, making it appear as an assumption rather than a citation of jira.text.field.character.limit default
DC convergence tests must inject the backend and sanitizer explicitly to the differ to avoid silently falling back to Cloud's configuration and testing the wrong deployment path

the comment ceiling 32767 is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit covering both description and comment fields per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519, not an unknown or mis-applied limit

comment truncation is identical in DC and Cloud (32767 limit, identical suffix marker) so convergence tests must use identity/recording checks rather than value assertions to prove the DC path executed
